Button$new()

Create a button.

Usage

Button$new(
  label = "Button",
  id = NULL,
  classes = NULL,
  style = NULL,
  disabled = FALSE,
  variant = "default"
)

Arguments

label

Button text, or a function of no arguments that returns it (re-evaluated when the signal()s it reads change).

id, classes, style, disabled

See Widget.

variant

One of "default", "primary", "success", "warning", "error".

Button$press()

Press the button: shows the pressed state briefly and sends a "button.pressed" message. Does nothing when disabled.

Usage

Button$press()

Returns

TRUE if the button was pressed.
